purpose: Five cinematic concept frames; not realtime screenshots

boards.title: MEMENTO
boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one cinematic art-direction board as a single uninterrupted 16:9 landscape keyframe, a plausible ultra high-end path-traced 3D website hero.
References: image 1 is the CURRENT Memento scene and locks the identity of the angular sculptures, NOT its crude materials, high camera or UI; image 2 is the TIDE target for cinematography, physical water, dark graphite and restrained amber edges; image 3 identifies the five actual icon silhouettes in its BOTTOM row. Do not use the incorrect outline navigation symbols in image 3's upper row.
One shared world: five dark sculptural icons on five evenly spaced vertices of a regular pentagon in a black lake. This shot focuses on ONE selected icon; any other platforms are distant, barely visible silhouettes in fog, never an extra foreground row. Camera almost at water level, about 20 cm above the lake, premium normal/short-tele lens with mild upward framing. A very thin large graphite circular disc is almost flush with the water, just 2 cm exposed, seamlessly blending into a dark clear reflection. No white or shiny silver pedestal; no floating thick plinth. Wet black water, readable physical mirror reflection broken by fine anisotropic ripples, subtle contact meniscus and a faint amber glint. No giant concentric neon rings.
Mood based on Belfast Sunset PureSky HDRI: warm overcast dusk glow low on the horizon, charcoal grey upper sky, pale warm backlight, restrained cool reflected fill. Layered remote mountain silhouettes disappear naturally into low volumetric mist; no visible low-poly mountains. 90% graphite and black, 10% amber #FF7950. Preserve detail in blacks. Materials: finely rough forged graphite / dark patinated metal, bevels catching narrow rim light, micro-scratches and fine stone-like grain at realistic scale, no plastic. Subtle volumetric shafts, minimal halation only around bright edges, soft lens bloom and extremely restrained film grain; no visible particles, sparks or decorative sci-fi beams. Hero silhouette and bevels sharp, distant world softly atmospheric. High-end cinematic CGI, tactile and calm, match the visual quality of reference 2.
Only one visible text element: the exact section title specified below, small, widely tracked off-white Inter-style typography, centered BELOW the stage over the lower dark water at about 90% of frame height. No logo, no TIDE wordmark, no nav, no counter, no buttons, no arrows, no HUD, no explanatory labels. Do not put the title on the disc. Leave generous breathing room around the hero and reflection.

Hero: preserve the central MEMENTO angular monogram silhouette from reference 1, the symmetrical constructed M with tall outer blades and diagonal crossing bars. It is a solid, thick, sculptural extruded dark-metal emblem, not a ribbon knot and not a generic typed letter M. A slight three-quarter camera reveals bevel depth while keeping the unmistakable monogram. Sculptural top around 20% frame, disc around 72%, reflection below. Soft warm rim from back left and a thin amber seam on selected inner edges; no filled orange surfaces.
Text (verbatim): "MEMENTO".
